hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "git commit"; then git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR | grep -E "\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|mts|json|css|md)$" | xargs -r npx prettier --write && git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR | grep -E "\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|mts|json|css|md)$" | xargs -r git add; fi'

bash -c 'FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"file_path\", \"\"))" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|mts|css)$"; then cd /home/user/sake-db-v2 && npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; fi'
